releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.76 adds local Voice Notes inside Notes. A note can contain text plus one or more voice recordings, or be saved as voice-only. Voice includes Start, Pause/Resume, Stop, local Play/Pause, duration, and per-clip removal. The Notes list shows a compact microphone summary, while existing Sketch, spell-check, Arabic/English direction, filters, sorting, grid/list view, pin/important and Price Photos behavior remain unchanged. Recordings stay on the phone; the existing Notes text/JSON backup does not copy the audio files themselves.
